example_sentences_in_bangla: তুমি তার নেক নজরে আছো, তাই কোনো চিন্তা নেই।
এই চাকরিতে নেক নজরে থাকলে সবকিছু সহজ হয়ে যাবে।
example_sentences_in_english: You are in his benevolent gaze, so no worries.
Being in the boss's good graces makes everything easier at work.
history: Originates from Persian-Urdu influence in Bengali, where 'nek' means good and 'nazar' refers to gaze, often used in Islamic cultural contexts to denote divine or favorable attention.
note: The idiom carries connotations of protection from evil eye through positive regard.
